affected_component: product_jobs._self_check_round fresh-probe wiring (owner-gated) + candidate-generation code projection for DraftError
invariant: The pre-freeze fresh-input agreement probe is an EXTRA gate: it may fail a self-check round only when the failure belongs to the controls it exists to run — ownership decided by the existing single ruler (_workspace_fixture_failure_owner) or an explicit CONTRACT owner in the payload. A drafter, provider or Harness failure means the probe could not run; the round proceeds on the drafted blueprints and records FRESH_AGREEMENT_PROBE_SKIPPED with the public codes, so the skip is visible on disk. Candidate generation projects a DraftError's public message as its code instead of the bare class name, so a failure never again reaches the journey as `DRAFTERROR`.
